query:
SELECT pbq.id, pbq.quoted_amount, pbq.labor_cost, pbq.parts_cost, pbq.status, LEFT(pbq.components_json, 500) as components_json_preview, LEFT(pbq.itemized_breakdown, 300) as breakdown_preview
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
WHERE pbq.claim_id = '6240003'
ORDER BY pbq.id;
